integrity: The proof uses the source's exact root-of-unity constructions but independently replays both finite-field patterns. Pairwise disjointness, dimension, the subcode enumerator, and generalized-weight bounds then follow from explicit supports; finite sweeps are only stress tests and are not used as infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The theorem identifies a large explicit subcode and lower bounds the ambient weight spectrum; it does not determine the full weight enumerator or exact generalized Hamming hierarchy. For \(s\equiv2\pmod4\), no maximality claim is made for the \(n/51\) disjoint minimum words.
title: Large repetition subcodes inside the new distance-five BCH family
